articles.title: Bitcoin circles $81.5K ETF cost basis as Trump Iran comments send stocks lower
articles.snippet: Bitcoin extended daily losses to 3% as US stocks came under pressure from President Donald Trump’s comments on Iran military action.

articles.title: PHP flaw draws millions of exploit attempts, Cloudflare CEO warns
articles.snippet: Cloudflare’s Matthew Prince said the network saw thousands of exploit attempts even before the PHP vulnerability was publicly disclosed.

articles.title: Solana’s Alpenglow launches on mainnet, targets 99% faster finality
articles.snippet: Solana’s first major consensus upgrade is targeting 99% finality reduction, seeking to offer users near-immediate transaction settlement and more responsive applications.

articles.title: Who Found the PHP Bug That Made Governments Unplug Their Websites? ChatGPT, Of Course
articles.snippet: OpenAI says its models found PHP2Shell and led a two-month coalition to fix it. It's the same AI that broke into Hugging Face and an Australian government portal this year.

articles.title: 'Mentality Issue': PlayStation Founder Waves Away Disc Ownership Anger
articles.snippet: PlayStation founder Ken Kutaragi pushed back against anger at Sony's decision to stop producing physical game discs.
